branch.description: The branch a previous agent worked this ticket on. Check it OUT (`git fetch origin && git checkout <branch>`); do not create a new one.

headCommit.description: The last commit recorded on this ticket — the predecessor got at least this far.

DONE.description: What the previous agent finished. Do not redo it.

NEXT.description: The first thing to do on resuming this lane. START HERE — this is the handover.

REJECTED.description: Approaches already tried and rejected. Do NOT re-attempt these; the cost was already paid.

UNCERTAIN.description: Open questions the predecessor could not settle.

lastCheckpoint.description: The predecessor's most recent checkpoint, or null if none was recorded (a branch may still be set — check it out anyway).

resume.description: HAS THIS LANE BEEN WORKED BEFORE? null = no prior work exists on this ticket; starting fresh from origin/main is safe. NON-NULL = a previous agent already worked this lane: `git fetch origin && git checkout <branch>` and continue from `lastCheckpoint.NEXT`. Do NOT run `git reset --hard origin/main` — it destroys their commits. Do not re-attempt anything listed under `lastCheckpoint.REJECTED`.

sprint.description: The sprint (named objective) the claimed task belongs to, or null. Non-null means this ticket serves a larger goal — read `goal` before working, and get_sprint for the full frontier.
